what: A buyer reports a pricing discrepancy for the Envato Elements Individual plan — advertised at $16.50/month but displayed as $33/month ($39 with VAT) at checkout.
verbatim_snippet: "Hi, I see Individual plan From $16.50/month but when I go to purchase this plan, it shows $33/m with vat it is $39. Why is the different showing?"
date: Accessed April 2026; page undated. Thread ID (~501171) suggests approximately 2025; date not confirmable.
notes: Envato Community Forums closed August 15, 2025; URL returns 403. Snippet from search engine index. The $16.50 figure is the annual-commitment price; $33 is the monthly price. VAT adds additional cost. Date uncertain — may be outside window.
